description: The TipMaster expert prediction for one football (soccer) match, found by team names ("Bayern vs Freiburg", one team name also works) or by id. Returns the most likely final score (mostLikelyScore, National only), the top 3 exact scores, and the home/draw/away split of three groups ranked by their own record: Top 20%, Top 25% and All players. Once played it carries the result. Shares are final once status is locked or played (a Classic match with status open still moves); the person asking has nothing to enter. Classic matches have no score (scoreRecorded false), only home/draw/away. A group with fewer than 20 players is withheld (reason). Other close matches are listed in alternatives.
name: get_match_prediction
title: Predict a soccer match
